data.one_liner: Record audio from the microphone with real-time amplitude monitoring and built-in playback.
data.what_it_does: Records audio to M4A format on iOS and Android while streaming normalized real-time amplitude values. It also includes built-in playback controls for recorded files.
use_when: You need to record voice or audio clips with live amplitude feedback on iOS and Android.
You want an easy way to play back recorded audio files within the same plugin.
avoid_when: Your app requires web or desktop support, as only iOS and Android are supported.
You need complex low-level audio processing beyond basic recording, playback, and amplitude streams.
strengths: Provides real-time amplitude streaming (0.0 to 1.0) out of the box.
Includes built-in playback controls (play, pause, stop).
Configurable recording settings like sample rate, channels, and audio quality.
weaknesses: Platform support is limited strictly to iOS and Android.
Does not support web or desktop targets.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding RECORD_AUDIO and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions to AndroidManifest.xml, and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription to Info.plist on iOS.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: A mature, highly popular package for recording audio to various formats across mobile, web, and desktop.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need comprehensive audio playback and sound management alongside recording options.
